question: Install meshtasticd on this Debian 12 (bookworm) machine using the beta channel from OpenSUSE Build Service. Steps: 1. Add the repo: echo 'deb http://download.opensuse.org/repositories/network:/Meshtastic:/beta/Debian_12/ /' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/network:Meshtastic:beta.list  2. Add GPG key: curl -fsSL https://download.opensuse.org/repositories/network:Meshtastic:beta/Debian_12/Release.key | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/network_Meshtastic_beta.gpg > /dev/null  3. sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y meshtasticd  After install, flash the Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3 (ESP32-S3, /dev/ttyUSB0) with Meshtastic firmware using the device-install tool. Report every step clearly.
